title: Apps for Caregivers Get a Dose of AI, but That Might Not Be Enough

claims.claim: AARP verilerine göre 2025 yılında tahmini 63 milyon Amerikalı yetişkin veya çocuk bakımı üstlenmiştir.

evidence.quote: According to AARP, in 2025, an estimated 63 million Americans cared for adults or children with a medical condition or disability.

claims.claim: Bakıcılar haftada ortalama 27 saate kadar bakım hizmeti sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: On average, these caregivers spend up to 27 hours per week providing care.
Medisafe, which was created in 2013, tracks medications and sends reminders so users don’t miss a dose.

Caring Village, which was founded in 2015, has an appointment calendar, a to-do list, and a wellness journal where users can keep track of their loved one’s symptoms and moods, and even upload a photo.

claims.claim: Bret Koncak 2022 yılında Mejo adlı web tabanlı bakım uygulamasını ortak kurmuştur.

evidence.quote: In 2022, Bret Koncak, based on his experiences with his two sons who have complex needs, cocreated Mejo, a web-based caregiver app.

claims.claim: Mejo uygulamasının premium versiyonu aylık 6 dolar veya yıllık 60 dolar tutarındadır.

evidence.quote: For $6 a month or $60 a year, the premium version of Mejo gives users access to daily journaling, which they can share with other caregivers, so everyone stays on the same page without having to catch up verbally.

claims.claim: Brett Rowell Briggzy adlı uygulamayı 2027 yılında daha geniş bir topluluğa sunmayı ummaktadır.

evidence.quote: Briggzy is currently in the testing phase, and Rowell hopes to launch it to a wider community in 2027.

Brett Rowell, whose son Briggs has cerebral palsy, is creating an app called Briggzy, so he and his wife, who work different hours, can more easily hand off their son’s care. Briggzy is currently in the testing phase, and Rowell hopes to launch it to a wider community in 2027.

claims.claim: Nasha Fitter, ortak kurucusu Farid Vij ile birlikte 2024 yılında Citizen Health'i piyasaya sürmüştür.

evidence.quote: Nasha Fitter, who has a daughter with a rare disease, launched Citizen Health in 2024 with cofounder Farid Vij to collect medical records for patients and store them in a secure portal.
